author: Akien
prose: We are at 46% usage and reset in 1d 19h. this: /home/akien/TheIgorsProject/.claude.old/hooks/update-usage.sh used to provide usage data to a widget that is no longer available, we have replaced it with a different one... but I'm thinking you need to be able to keep an eye on it, as an orchestrator, and then drive the cc_0 boxes accordingly. and work out any issues with cross host development. if only one cc per box is running, and you're keeping a close eye on usage, we should do pretty well. what do you think? ... the code was the right and could be a hook again, writing a json file that you could just look at any time you wanted to. maybe it's a tool call, i dunno. i leave that to you.
